title: Fix 3 bugs in go_legacy_products handlers
description: Brownfield Go dirty scenario: createProduct, getProduct, and deleteProduct each have a bug. Fix them so all 4 tests pass.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix the 3 bugs in internal/products/products.go so all 4 tests pass.

  func createProduct:
    — returns http.StatusOK (200) instead of http.StatusCreated (201)
    — fix: w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)

  func getProduct:
    — inverted comparison: returns items where p.ID != id (should be == id)
    — fix: change 'p.ID != id' to 'p.ID == id'

  func deleteProduct:
    — wrong TrimPrefix: '/products' should be '/products/'
    — fix: strings.TrimPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/products/")

Do not modify the test file.
Run: go test ./...
required_artifacts: getProduct uses == comparison for ID match
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
